args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Per the runbook, I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent production release that was healthy, in all three production regions. Post-rollback status: all regions on v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production and should not be redeployed until it is fixed. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and confirm checkout traffic and error rates are normal.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent production release that was healthy. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy and was running in every region, with an error rate of 0.18.
- **Current state:** All regions are on v2.3.0, healthy, with an error rate of 0.002.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to open INC-0001 timed out. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the retry returned a single incident, so there should be no duplicate. The summary records the rollback and says v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is fixed.

Next step is for the on-call engineer to investigate the v2.3.1 failure and confirm checkout traffic is back to normal.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production and is currently serving all three regions. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
The rollback is complete and checkout-api is healthy again. Now I'll open the SEV2 incident.
